anomalies.description: A woman fires a handgun; visible muzzle flash and bullet impact debris on the wall at the moment of discharge.
A soldier stands over a person lying motionless on a bed in a hotel room, appearing to threaten or assault them; the victim is supine and unresponsive.

A woman in a white top and dark pants engages in close-quarters physical combat with a person in camouflage attire on a staircase; she appears to strike or grapple the opponent, who is bent forward and recoiling.
The woman and a soldier engage in close-quarters physical combat on a staircase, with the woman striking or grappling the soldier.
The combat continues as the person in camouflage is pushed or falls down a short flight of stairs while the woman remains standing above; motion blur indicates rapid movement and physical contact.

The woman stands on an upper landing holding a white cloth (possibly torn clothing) while the opponent in camouflage is below, suggesting a continuation of the struggle with the woman gaining advantage.
Two men engage in close physical combat: one man grabs the other from behind and attempts to control him, while the second man struggles and turns to confront him.
A man aims a silver semi-automatic pistol with both hands in a ready-to-fire stance; the gun is clearly visible and pointed forward, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
